messages.subject: Issue Deploying Apps
parts:
Hello,

I'm pushing a daily update to my app, and haven't changed any code.  It runs locally, but when I deploy it the page returns the following error:

An error has occurred


The application exited unexpectedly due to a dropped connection.

socket hang up

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:50696/opt/shiny-server/scripts/shiny-run


Is anyone else experiencing this?

messages.author: c83706cf72fdd15b
messages.subject: Re: Issue Deploying Apps
parts: FYI - I removed any extraneous variables using rm(), and now it seems to deploy.  So I'm not sure what the offending variable was.. but people having issues deploying their apps may want to take a couple minutes to do some workspace cleanup to see if that solves the problem!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Issue Deploying Apps
parts: Sorry for the delay in responding, but I am reasonably sure that when you see:  "Killed"  it is an indication that the application you have deployed is taking up more memory than what the default container allows for.  You can configure your application with a larger container and that should alleviate those cases.
On Fri, Aug 29, 2014 at 10:33 AM, Kevin Griffith <kevin.g...@gmail.com> wrote:
